The templates

Source: R/tpl_registry.R
tfl_templates.Rd

Every table and figure template takes the same pair of filters, its input form's first group with population: subset (which subjects: R on the analysis set's ADSL) and, with records data, where (which records). Both are NULL by default; see tfl_param().

Usage

tfl_templates()

Value

A data frame, one row a template: name, kind, layout, params (its parameters, comma-separated), package (the package that registered it: tflspec, or a company's, tfl_template()) and call (the function its program calls, the A use).

Examples

tfl_templates()

#> 2         ae_eair   table hierarchical
#> 3    ae_max_grade   table hierarchical
#> 4     ae_overview   table      summary
